Total current is Iref+Itail = 50 uA, so worst-case power is 1.98 V x 50 uA = 99 uW (<170 uW). The OTA is a follower, so GBW = gm1/(2pi(CL+C1)) must be >>20*fc*Q. PARAMS = {
    "fc":        (34e3, 29.9e3, 39e3),    # target -3 dB cutoff [Hz]
    "q":         (0.68, 0.60, 0.70),      # pole Q (<=0.707 -> no peaking)
    "C2":        (20e-12, 5e-12, 100e-12),# SK ground capacitor [F]
    "Itail":     (40e-6, 20e-6, 80e-6),   # OTA tail current [A]
    "Iref":      (10e-6, 5e-6, 20e-6),    # bias reference current [A]
    "gmid_in":   (16, 12, 18),            # input pair gm/Id (low Vov -> low Vgs)
    "L_in":      (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),        # input pair length [um]
    "gmid_tail": (14, 10, 18),            # tail/reference gm/Id (low Vdsat)
    "L_tail":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # tail/reference length [um]
    "gmid_load": (10, 6, 14),             # PMOS mirror load gm/Id
    "L_load":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # PMOS mirror load length [um]
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vcm = spec.get("vcm", 0.9)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 10e-12)

    # --- Sallen-Key unity-gain LPF values (R1 = R2 = R) ---
    # w0 = 1/(R*sqrt(C1*C2)),  Q = 0.5*sqrt(C1/C2)  ->  C1 = 4 Q^2 C2
    w0 = 2 * PI * p["fc"]
    C2 = p["C2"]
    C1 = 4.0 * p["q"] ** 2 * C2
    R = 1.0 / (w0 * math.sqrt(C1 * C2))

    # --- bias and OTA currents ---
    Iin = 0.5 * p["Itail"]
    ref = lut.size("n", p["gmid_tail"], p["L_tail"], p["Iref"], vds=0.6)   # diode nfet
    tail = lut.size("n", p["gmid_tail"], p["L_tail"], p["Itail"], vds=0.2)  # same gm/Id, L
    pair = lut.size("n", p["gmid_in"], p["L_in"], Iin, vds=0.4)
    load = lut.size("p", p["gmid_load"], p["L_load"], Iin, vds=0.5)

    n = Netlist("vin vout vdd vss ibias")

    # bias: IREF flows VDD -> ibias, diode-connected nfet sinks it
    n.dev("MREF", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", ref)
    n.dev("MTAIL", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", tail)

    # 5T OTA: M1 non-inverting (n2), M2 inverting (vout, unity feedback)
    n.dev("M1", "a", "n2", "tail", "vss", pair)
    n.dev("M2", "vout", "vout", "tail", "vss", pair)
    n.dev("M3", "a", "a", "vdd", "vdd", load)        # diode-connected PMOS load
    n.dev("M4", "vout", "a", "vdd", "vdd", load)     # mirror to output

    # Sallen-Key network: vin -R1- n1 -R2- n2 ; C1 n1->vout ; C2 n2->vss
    n.R("R1", "vin", "n1", R)
    n.R("R2", "n1", "n2", R)
    n.C("C1", "n1", "vout", C1)
    n.C("C2", "n2", "vss", C2)

    # --- first-order predictions ---
    q = p["q"]
    x = 10.0                                   # f_stop / fc
    atten = 10.0 * math.log10((1.0 - x * x) ** 2 + (x / q) ** 2)
    if q > 1.0 / math.sqrt(2.0):
        peak = 20.0 * math.log10(q / math.sqrt(1.0 - 1.0 / (4.0 * q * q)))
    else:
        peak = 0.0
    gbw = pair.gm / (2 * PI * (cl + C1))       # OTA GBW driving CL + feedback C
    headroom = vcm - pair.vgs - tail.vdsat      # tail saturation margin at nominal
    power_worst = 1.98 * (p["Iref"] + p["Itail"])  # worst supply

    preds = {
        "fc": p["fc"],
        "q": q,
        "atten_db": atten,
        "peaking_db": peak,
        "power": power_worst,
        "gbw": gbw,
        "gbw_over_f0q": gbw / (p["fc"] * q),
        "tail_headroom": headroom,
    }
    return n, preds
